title: ApiCommand
responsibility: Exposes API resource reads, contract definitions, screenshot downloads and agent lifecycle operations through the Harness CLI.

inputs.name: ApiCommand.register.program
inputs.description: Required Commander program to receive API subcommands and options. Screenshot --size WIDTHxHEIGHT is optional, defaults to JavaScript undefined (no CSS size filter), and is mutually exclusive with --viewport; each dimension is a canonical integer 1-16384. Existing --viewport id selection and default no-filter behavior remain.

outputs.name: ApiCommand.register
outputs.description: Registers API resource reads, screenshot downloads, contract and agent actions. Screenshot downloads select sealed evidence; they never launch a browser or resize images. Registration returns no value.

errors.name: Invalid screenshot selection
errors.description: The registered screenshot action rejects malformed/out-of-bounds --size and --size/--viewport conflicts before network/file access. Commander rejects missing option arguments and unknown options.

errors.name: API operation error
errors.description: Invoking a registered action propagates its API, authorization and file-system failures; registration itself performs no API request.
